sources.entry: Bitcart - Cryptocurrencies payment processor and development platform. (Demo, Source Code) MIT Docker/Python/Nodejs

summary.one_liner: Bitcart is a self-hostable cryptocurrency payment processor and development platform for merchants, users and developers, per its README and the awesome-selfhosted listing.
summary.what_it_does: The README is short and mostly describes the project as an ecosystem of linked repositories rather than documenting features in detail. It describes Bitcart as a platform for merchants, users and developers that aims for easy setup and use. The listed components include core daemons and a merchants API, an admin panel, a ready-made store, Docker packaging used as the base for all deployment methods, a Python library for coin connections, and the BitCCL scripting language for automating checkout flow. Documentation is kept in a separate docs repository and a contributing guide is referenced. The README does not give detailed feature lists or setup steps.
use_cases: run a crypto checkout for an online store
build payment integrations as a developer
notable: Multi-repository ecosystem with core daemons, admin panel, store, Docker packaging and coin connection library
BitCCL scripting language for checkout flow automation
Docker packaging is the base for all deployment methods
Listed on awesome-selfhosted under money and management
caveats: README gives no setup or run instructions; see the linked docs repository
Detailed feature and coin support is not stated in this README
